City Centre location
The Apartment

Modern living in
historic Chernivtsi

Chorni Vivtsy is a boutique property of 5 individually designed apartments on Shevchenka Street, steps from Chernivtsi's most celebrated landmarks — the iconic Olha Kobylyanska pedestrian street, the Armenian Church, Shevchenko Park, and the Cathedral of the Holy Spirit.

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with warm aesthetics and modern comforts — whether you're visiting for a weekend escape or an extended stay, Chorni Vivtsy offers a genuinely local Chernivtsi experience.
